name: Mjortvye Glaza
source:
Fyur moves to a new city and immediately gets into trouble. To avoid problems, he agrees to look after a blind girl.

At first he feels weird about getting entrusted with a task this important while being a complete stranger. Soon enough, though, he finds out that no one else was willing to take on the job: a local urban legend has it that if you look in the girl's lifeless eyes, you'll get cursed.
